mapper.select: select a.model_name from t_model_history a where a.is_deleted = 0 and a.groups_id = #{groupId} and a.elemen_id = #{element} order by a.create_date desc limit 1

SELECT mh.user_id, bm.id AS modelId, bm.english_name modelName, mh.elemen_id AS elementId, hr.role, hr.record, hr.word_number, hr.record_time AS second FROM t_model_history mh LEFT JOIN t_history_record hr ON mh.id = hr.history_id and hr.is_deleted =0 LEFT JOIN t_basic_model bm ON mh.model_id = bm.id and bm.is_deleted =0 WHERE mh.is_deleted =0 and mh.groups_id = #{groupId} AND mh.elemen_id = #{elementId} ORDER BY hr.id ASC
select user_id from t_model_history where is_deleted = 0 and elemen_id = #{elementId} and groups_id = #{groupId} order by id

select a.user_id, c.username userName, #{elementId} elementId, a.model_name, b.record, b.record_time, b.role, b.word_number from t_model_history a left join t_history_record b on a.id = b.history_id and b.is_deleted = 0 left join sys_user c on a.user_id = c.id and c.is_deleted = 0 where a.is_deleted = 0 and a.elemen_id = #{elementId} and a.groups_id = #{groupId} and a.user_id = #{userId} order by b.id asc
